notes: Play with a partner now opens a setup panel on the main menu: pick co-op or versus, a difficulty and a name (or host your saved campaign), then Host game. The code shows in large type with a Copy button. Joining is on the same panel

New Multiplayer section in Settings: host the campaign you are playing right now (co-op or versus), see and copy the code and whether your partner is connected, end the session, or leave a game you joined. Hosted campaigns now save like any other
